author: Animalogic
description:
Giant Beavers were the largest rodents in North America. They grew the size of a bear and ruled ponds with iron teeth. The size is a given. It was a behemoth. But the more we learn about it the less it looks like beaver. In some ways it seems to more like a giant muskrat-capybara hybrid. So really was the giant beaver?

00:00 Giant Beavers: The Prehistoric Rodents You Didn't Know Existed

02:52 Extrapolation Errors & Demoting the Beaver Guide

08:29 Miocene Climate Shifts & Wood-Cutting History
09:55 Tooth Structure & Isotope Analysis (Diets Exposed)
12:09 The Truth About Dams and Lodges

Examining the nature of the beast.

title: This Ice Age Giant Wasn't Built Like a Beaver
